entries.note: AFARS was reissued for the RFO in June 2026 (combined PDF on army.mil); services-oversight text moved to 5137.890-1 through -4 with thresholds in Appendix GG and content in PGI 5137.890-4. acquisition.gov still serves the July 2025 AFARS.
